subject: dsa
title: Insertion Sort
summary: Grow a sorted prefix on the left. Take each next value and slide it back until it sits in the right spot among the already-sorted values.
problem: Sort ascending by inserting each element into its correct position among the already-sorted elements before it.

steps.caption: Insertion sort: grow a sorted prefix on the left. Take each next value and slide it back to its right spot.
The first element alone counts as sorted. Take 1 (index 1) to insert into the prefix.
1 is less than 5, so it slides to the front. Prefix: [1, 5].
Take 4 (index 2). Slide it left past 5, but stop before 1.
Take 2 (index 3). Slide it past 5 and 4, stop just after 1.
2 lands just after 1. The array is sorted: [1, 2, 4, 5].
